For My Chinnna Pullliiii

#happppiieee birthdayyyy chellllliiii ❤️🥹🫶🏻

College lo kalisina oka person ivvala naa life lo intha important person avuthav ani appudu assalu anukoledu. Nuvvu just naa friend kaadhu, literally sister from another mother ayipoyav. 🫂

Mana friendship lo unna aa silly fights, endless conversations, random outings, navvukunnavi, edchukunnavi, okariki okaram support cheskunnavi… anni naaku chaala special. 🥹❤️

Naa happiness lo, naa bad times lo, nannu judge cheyyakunda naatho nilabadina person nuvve. Konni relationships blood tho kaadhu, heart tho form avuthayi ani mana bond prove chesthundi. 🫂

Eppudu ilage happy ga, crazy ga, innocent ga undu. Nee life lo nuvvu korukunna prati okkati achieve cheyyali, nee face lo ee smile eppudu alane undali.

Mana college days aipoyina, mana memories and mana bond matram eppatiki alaane undali. ❤️

Once again, Happiest Birthday naa chinnna pullliiii… 🎂🎀

Annaaa will alwaysss loves youuu! 🥹❤️
